<!-- pr-reviewer: 5a044ce67acb0d0180d15ee443667b43af5c87e8 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (independent review of head 5a044ce; the earlier blocker is closed).

### What looks good
- **Earlier BLOCKER fixed.** `lathe_plan` (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_lathe.rs`, the `arcs_about` gate after the axis is built) refuses any program with arcs about the spindle by name at plan time: `LATHE_THREAD_REFUSAL` for a Thread tool, `LATHE_HELIX_REFUSAL` otherwise. The "skewed chord" path is no longer reachable from a generated threading op.
- **Pinning test is real.** `lathe_field_tools::a_generated_threading_op_refuses_the_field_by_name` generates a Threading op (asserts the kernel wrote arcs), then asserts the error names the op and `LATHE_THREAD_REFUSAL`, does not contain "skewed", and is not the helix refusal.
- **Changelog now honest.** Both the Changelog line and the module docs say threading is still refused by name; only groove/part and form are cut (axial thread passes are cut with the V).
- **Both earlier nits addressed.** `profile_of` passes the tool's raw `corner_r` / `nose_radius` through and `profile.validate()` refuses NaN, oversize and too-wide-form profiles by name at plan time; no clamp, no rectangle stand-in.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; `field_cut.rs` is now 245 lines, `stock_sim_lathe.rs` 162. Decision file `docs/decisions/21-blade-sweep.md` present. No build.rs / .github / scripts / Cargo changes; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; no golden changes.

### Local results (trial merge with current origin/main: already up to date, no conflicts)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| sim `stock_lathe_blade` | 5 passed |
| sim `stock_lathe` | 7 passed |
| sim lib | 55 passed |
| app `lathe_field_sim` | 6 passed |
| app `lathe_field_tools` | 2 passed |
| app `turning_*` (axial_rapids, blade, bore, bore_feeds, contour, form, profile, stock_approach, thread) | 2 / 14 / 11 / 3 / 10 / 8 / 6 / 3 / 8 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Per AGENTS.md this is a `feat`, so it merges at the next minor cut. The PR is still a draft; it is being marked ready with `merge-ready`.
- I did not re-verify that the threading test fails without the gate; the fixture assert on `arc_count() > 0` plus the "no skewed" assert make the intent clear.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
